notes.title: Small update and important information!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we released a small update that allows you to:
-Change the speed of the game (Important: Some users have noticed an error in which the game gave out a very low FPS instead of 60. Therefore, I recommend setting the speed to maximum) For users who have a stable game of 60 FPS, we recommend not to change the speed of the game.
-Also for users who have a too sharp picture added the ability to enable anti-aliasing.

Attention: We will soon start developing FOS on a new engine to avoid many bugs that cause the game to crash all the time.

Thank you for the attention :)

notes.title: Error correction
notes.notes:
This update fixes:
- Periodic crashes of the game that occurred during the game.
- The menu exit system has been changed, now you need to hold down ESC for a few seconds to exit the menu.
- Some graphical errors have been fixed.

Thank you all so much for playing our game :)
We have been working on a new project for a long time, so there is absolutely not enough time.

notes.title: Final update!
notes.notes:
Today comes the last final update that adds 10 new endings to the game. Various bugs and bugs were fixed. Also, many errors in the text were corrected thanks to Darnery who worked on our text in the game, in the Russian localization!

notes.title: Lost island
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you all for your support, with this update, the game is out of early access, and after the latest update is planned that will add 10 final endings to the game![/b]

[h2]This update is waiting for you: [/h2]
An underwater world filled with mysterious traps and dangers. Find 15 new endings that are hidden in the underwater world and on land, as well as find a pirate ship that sailed from unknown lands.

Some bugs were fixed and it was possible to skip both texts after the end.
The game also added 10 new skins, 5 of which you can get during the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36670036/d9c153e04327dac6b3c0674719f01463710a0ece.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
Small bugfix:
Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze after striking a demon with a sword.
Fixed a bug with a portal in space.
Increased the dialog window time.
Fixed a couple of things where the camera didn't go to the player.
And also now the portal to the imprisoned master, which requires 50 endings, and works without restrictions.

notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
[h1]New major update!!![/h1]

[h2]this update is waiting for you:[/h2]

[b]a Great new adventure in space, 25 new endings not to be forgotten both in space and on earth, 10 new skins were added 5 of which you can find during the game, as well as a weapon rack was added in which you will be able to put your items that would not look for them every time in a new way, and to all this, 3 music discs were scattered around the world, with the discovery of which you will be able to find new soundtracks in the menu!
So what are you waiting for! Forward to new adventures![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36670036/2d27006e44b18706ad1d65acced86a3d42d3deb1.png[/img]

[b]and now the most important thing to fix the spaceship you need to find the master deep in the dungeon, to which the path leads through a portal on the second floor of the damned impregnable fortress! But keep in mind that the portal will work after you unlock 50 endings! Don't forget that the development of the spacecraft has moved far to the West! [/b]
